evidence.purpose: Approved 6173-frame story schedule, section roles, and authored cue ranges.
Approved Dynamite asset identity, duration, frame count, and audio hash.
Front-facing interview review and retained Dynamite transition evidence.

interview_policy.reason: The 205.8-second full take remains outside the editable catalog. Participants edit bounded sections, then the full-song review combines the current version of all five sections with the original full-length audio.

segments.name: Dynamite — Intro / First Drop
segments.boundary_basis: Ends at the approved story boundary after the 9.0-second intro and first 32.2-second drop.
segments.rationale: Keeps the reviewed opening build and its complete first energetic handoff in one concise default demo.

segments.name: Dynamite — Climax Drop (Jump)
segments.boundary_basis: Ends at the approved global action-range boundary for the climax jump cue.
segments.rationale: Preserves the complete jump accent rather than cutting the authored motion at the midpoint of the long climax drop.

segments.name: Dynamite — Climax Drop (Punch)
segments.boundary_basis: Runs from the completed jump cue to the approved end of the long climax drop.
segments.rationale: Contains the approved late arm-punch accent and stops before the separate chest-pop phrase.

segments.name: Dynamite — Chorus Handoff
segments.boundary_basis: Spans the approved chest-pop drop and short chorus, ending seven recovery frames after the complete side-step cue.
segments.rationale: Names the actual multi-section handoff without presenting the entire 31-second choice as chorus.

segments.name: Dynamite — Final Drop / Outro
segments.boundary_basis: Uses the remaining approved final drop and complete 11.5-second outro, exactly 45 seconds.
segments.rationale: Retains the turn transition and the closing rise-and-reach resolution as one complete ending choice.
